cues.en: As a reminder, the idea of language models is to go from text to token indices to embeddings, and
cues.zh: 複習一下，語言模型的流程，是從文字到 token 索引，再到嵌入，

cues.en: then you go on embeddings back to tokens and of course, back to human readable text.
cues.zh: 接著，從嵌入轉回 token，當然，最後轉回人類可讀的文字。

cues.en: Now, of course, there's all sorts of complicated stuff happening in here, and this is basically the topic of the rest of the course.
cues.zh: 中間有各種複雜運作，基本上就是接下來課程的主題。

cues.en: But essentially all of these billions of parameters and computations happening in these attention layers
cues.zh: 但本質上，注意力層中數十億參數與計算，

cues.en: are really just about taking the embeddings vectors, transforming them in some way, and then giving another vector from which a token can be selected.
cues.zh: 只是取出嵌入向量，以某種方式轉換，再提供另一個向量，據此選出 token。

cues.en: But if we ignore all of that sophistication for now, then basically a language model is an embedding
cues.zh: 先忽略那些複雜細節，語言模型基本上，就是把 token ID 嵌入，

cues.en: token ID and then an embedding to get another token ID.
cues.zh: 再反嵌入，取得另一個 token ID。

cues.en: So the embeddings matrix is a way to transform an embeddings vector from a dense floating point representation
cues.zh: 因此，反嵌入矩陣，是把稠密浮點數表示的嵌入向量，

cues.en: back into integers that are then translated into text Tokens.
cues.zh: 轉回整數，再轉成文字 token 的方法。

cues.en: Now, so far in the previous and in this sections, we've been focusing on these parts of the model here.
cues.zh: 前一章與這一章，目前著重這些部分，

cues.en: So getting from text to tokens to embeddings.
cues.zh: 也就是從文字到 token，再到嵌入。

cues.en: And now the goal of this challenge is to understand this part up here.
cues.zh: 這個挑戰，則要理解上方這部分，

cues.en: So where do these embeddings come from and how do we translate them into tokens.
cues.zh: 也就是反嵌入從哪裡來，以及如何轉成 token。

cues.en: Let me answer this question first where these embeddings vectors come from.
cues.zh: 先回答反嵌入矩陣從哪裡來。

cues.en: So embeddings matrices can come from one of two sources.
cues.zh: 反嵌入矩陣，可以有兩種來源。

cues.en: They can be trained based on data just like any other set of model weights.
cues.zh: 可以根據資料訓練，和模型其他權重相同；

cues.en: Or they can be copied from the embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 也可以從嵌入矩陣複製。

cues.en: So let me discuss the trained source first.
cues.zh: 先談訓練這個來源。

cues.en: If the embeddings matrix is trained then it's initialized as random numbers.
cues.zh: 如果反嵌入矩陣是訓練出來的，先以隨機數初始化。

cues.en: And all of those numbers are model parameters.
cues.zh: 所有數字都是模型參數，

cues.en: They are weights that are learned and optimized through gradient descent, just like any other trained parameters in the model.
cues.zh: 是透過梯度下降學習、最佳化的權重，和模型其他訓練參數相同。

cues.en: This is advantageous because it allows for the Unembedding matrix to be optimized for task performance,
cues.zh: 優點是，能針對任務表現，最佳化反嵌入矩陣，

cues.en: which is often expressed as the accuracy with which a model can predict a missing token.
cues.zh: 通常以模型預測缺少 token 的準確度表示。

cues.en: But it also means a lot of additional parameters to train, and many language model development papers
cues.zh: 但也意味著，需要訓練大量額外參數。而許多語言模型開發論文，

cues.en: have actually reported that when comparing trained to tied on embeddings matrices, the performance
cues.zh: 比較獨立訓練與共享權重的反嵌入矩陣後，發現表現

cues.en: is not noticeably different, so it's not really clear whether requiring all the extra data and extra
cues.zh: 沒有明顯不同。因此，多花額外資料與

cues.en: computational power to train the Unembedding matrix matrix is really that beneficial.
cues.zh: 計算能力，訓練反嵌入矩陣，是否真的有益，並不清楚。

cues.en: And that leads us to the other source of UN embeddings matrix, which is to tie them to the embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 這就帶到另一種來源：與嵌入矩陣共享權重。

cues.en: Now, this word tied is a very specific term in deep learning, and it basically just means that the matrix is a copy of another weight matrix somewhere else in the model.
cues.zh: 這裡的 tied，是深度學習中的特定術語，基本上指矩陣是模型中，另一個權重矩陣的副本。

cues.en: In this context, it means that the embeddings matrix is not actually trained or even initialized.
cues.zh: 這個情境下，反嵌入矩陣其實不另外訓練，甚至不另外初始化，

cues.en: It's literally just copied from the embeddings model.
cues.zh: 而是直接從嵌入矩陣複製。

cues.en: Now we do need to transpose the embeddings matrix for reasons that I will explain later in the video, but that's more for linear algebra mechanics than for any actual theoretical reason.
cues.zh: 不過，必須轉置嵌入矩陣，原因稍後解釋；這比較是線性代數運算的需要，而非理論理由。

cues.en: The advantage of using embeddings matrix for the embeddings is that you don't need any additional training,
cues.zh: 用嵌入矩陣作為反嵌入的好處，是不需要額外訓練，

cues.en: which saves both computation time, and it also allows gradient descent to focus more on training the other parameters, for example in the attention heads.
cues.zh: 節省計算時間，也讓梯度下降更專注訓練其他參數，例如注意力頭。

cues.en: On the other hand, it is possible that the transformed embedding space is different from the initial embedding space.
cues.zh: 另一方面，經過轉換的嵌入空間，可能與初始嵌入空間不同。

cues.en: And if that's the case, it would mean that reusing the initial embeddings for the embeddings might
cues.zh: 若如此，重用初始嵌入來做反嵌入，

cues.en: actually be forcing the attention transformed embeddings vectors into a coordinate space that is suboptimal.
cues.zh: 可能迫使注意力轉換後的嵌入向量，進入不夠理想的座標空間。
